messages:
Ivy: Heads-up — promote blocked, deploy-bot aborted canary due to artifact upload error.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: job `canary-integration` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/1747701234 :warning:
Noel: Quick grep shows `checksum mismatch finalizing multipart upload` and `cache-metadata: version=3` vs server expecting `version=2`.
Sasha: That matches the toolchain bump from yesterday that upgraded our proto gen. Which PR was that? @Noel
Noel: PR #918 updated protobuf-gen and bumped cache metadata version. It passed unit tests but integration with artifact-store failed.
release-coordinator: We have a 1.5h change window. Options: pin promo runner to last-good builder image, or rollback the proto-gen bump now (would delay).
Ivy: Pinning keeps release on schedule; fallback is rollback but that would likely push the window. Thoughts?
Sasha: Pin + follow-up compatibility job seems safest. We'll need a documented follow-up task: run cache-compat matrix + coord with artifact-store team.
Noel: I'll open a hot MR to pin `redwood/builder:2026-03-12-stable` in the promo pipeline and trigger a rerun. ETA 12m.
deploy-bot: Manual retrigger requested by Noel — job queued: https://ci.redwood/queue/1747701234 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
oncall-bot: Incident created CI_ARTIFACT_1747701234 and acknowledged. Escalate if unresolved in 50m.
Ivy: Add a one-line release-note: "Promotion pinned to previous builder image due to artifact cache metadata drift; compatibility verification pending." Tag `requires-followup`.
Noel: MR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/441 — started canary rerun.
deploy-bot: Canary rerun started, step `artifact-upload` running.
cache-bot: Noted: artifact-store schema currently at v2. Will stand up a v3-compat shim if needed.
Sasha: If rerun succeeds we promote and schedule a post-release compatibility canary and a tracker ticket for schema reconciliation. If it fails we reconvene and consider delaying the change window.
Ivy: Execute pin path. Keep updates in-thread. :thumbsup:
